verification_candidates.claim_text: Hypothyroidism or Hashimoto's can maybe be cured or reversed naturally without medication, depending on many factors.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: The true answer is maybe, and it depends on a boatload of factors
verification_candidates.rationale: A claim that an autoimmune thyroid disease can be cured without medication could lead patients to forgo treatment.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Doctors prescribe antidepressants to patients who report low mood, weight gain, insomnia, hair loss and constipation.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: My hair is falling out and I can't go to the bathroom and you get handed an antidepressant.
verification_candidates.rationale: A claim about prescribing practice that implies missed thyroid diagnoses and affects trust in doctors.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Hormone replacement, including T4 and T3 thyroid hormone, can be tailored to lab results to bring hormone levels back up.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: We can tailor all hormone replacement to you to literally match up with what we're seeing in your labs and bring those hormone levels.
verification_candidates.rationale: A treatment claim about individualized hormone replacement that clinical evidence can assess.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Vitamin D is a hormone, and taking vitamin D supplements replaces a hormone that is deficient in the body.
verification_candidates.rationale: A physiological classification claim used to argue for hormone replacement.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Vitamin D levels need to be between 80 and 100 for all hormone production.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: Your vitamin D levels need to be between 80 and 100 FYI. And that's for all hormone production.
verification_candidates.rationale: A specific target blood level well above usual reference ranges that could drive high-dose supplementation.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Vitamin D is needed to cure hypothyroidism naturally.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: And we will get to that when we talk about curing your hypothyroidism naturally. You're going to need vitamin D.
verification_candidates.rationale: Presents vitamin D as part of a natural cure for hypothyroidism, a treatment claim evidence can test.

verification_candidates.claim_text: In type 1 diabetes the pancreas no longer produces the right amount of insulin.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: because their pancreas just no longer produces the right amount of insulin.
verification_candidates.rationale: A mechanistic statement about type 1 diabetes used as the basis for an analogy to thyroid replacement.

verification_candidates.claim_text: People with type 1 diabetes need insulin to live and will die without it.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: Insulin is needed for life and without it, they will die.
verification_candidates.rationale: A risk claim about withholding insulin in type 1 diabetes.

verification_candidates.claim_text: A person is not going to die immediately without thyroid hormone, but someone whose thyroid is removed and not replaced with thyroid hormone would die, because thyroid hormone is needed to survive.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: if we removed your thyroid and did not replace it with thyroid hormone replacement, i.e. medication, you would die.
verification_candidates.rationale: A claim about the consequences of untreated thyroid hormone absence that bears on adherence to replacement therapy.
